name: Windows GitHub Runner VM
description: Creates a Windows Server 2025 QEMU/KVM VM that installs unattended and registers itself as a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner (Windows service). Windows cannot run in an LXC container, so this is delivered as a VM. The install uses an AHCI disk and E1000 NIC so no VirtIO drivers are needed to complete setup; the VirtIO ISO is attached for optional performance upgrades afterwards.

notes.text: Upload a Windows Server 2025 ISO to an ISO-content storage before running; the script lists available ISOs for selection.
You must provide a runner registration token (repo/org Settings -> Actions -> Runners -> New self-hosted runner). Registration tokens are short-lived, so run the script soon after generating one.
On the first boot only, press a key at 'Press any key to boot from CD...' to launch the unattended installer. Subsequent boots skip it automatically.
The Administrator password is randomly generated and printed once at the end of the script - save it immediately.
